newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Miner killed, 15 trapped at Western Deep.
newsitem.headline: Miner killed, 15 trapped at Western Deep.

text.p: One mineworker has been killed and 15 remain trapped about 3,300 metres underground after a seismic event at Western Deep Levels Ltd's east mine, managers Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Monday.
A further 17 mineworkers were injured in the accident and have been admitted to hospital.
Anglo said rescue workers were attempting to reach the men who remained trapped between 3,200 and 3,300 metres underground.
The accident was caused by a seismic event which occurred at 0720 GMT and measured 3.1 on the Richter scale.
Anglo said further details would be released as they became available.
Western Deep produced 7,830 kg of gold in the three months to end September.
